query: Historical dates when NIFC declared National Preparedness Level 5 (PL5) each year 2015-2025, and what month/date PL5 was first reached each year
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary of findings on NIFC National Preparedness Level 5 (PL5) dates, 2015–2025:

## Key Findings

**National PL5 was reached in only 6 of 11 years** (2015, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2024). It was **NOT reached** in 2016, 2019, 2022, 2023, or 2025.

| Year | Date PL5 First Reached | Reached? |
|------|------------------------|----------|
| 2015 | **August 12, 2015** | Yes |
| 2016 | — (peaked PL4) | No |
| 2017 | **August 10, 2017** | Yes |
| 2018 | **July 27, 2018** (2 p.m. MDT) | Yes |
| 2019 | — (peaked PL3) | No |
| 2020 | **August 18, 2020** | Yes |
| 2021 | **July 14, 2021** (earliest in window) | Yes |
| 2022 | — (peaked PL4) | No |
| 2023 | — (peaked PL2) | No |
| 2024 | **July 18, 2024** | Yes |
| 2025 | — (peaked PL4) | No |

**Timing pattern:** July onsets in 2018/2021/2024; August onsets in 2015/2017/2020. The earliest date in the window was July 14, 2021. NIFC's 10-year monthly averages put July at PL3 and August at PL4, so PL5 always represents above-normal escalation.

**Authoritative sourcing:** The findings are anchored on two primary NIFC/NICC sources — the historical preparedness-level transition table (gacc.nifc.gov) and the 2025 NICC Annual Report, which provides official days-at-each-PL counts (2015=24, 2017=39, 2018=34, 2020=45, 2021=68, 2024=59 days at PL5; all non-PL5 years = 0). These cross-validate each other and contemporaneous federal press releases. For context (outside the window), 2026 reached PL5 on July 18 — the same calendar date as 2024.
